networks.name: preflight
networks.description: Checks an open agentic website against the Worldwide Agentic Web MVP spec, explains each failure, writes corrected files, and runs the checked network as a peer.
sample_queries: Check https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/adrian-erlikhman/preflight@main/fixtures/common-mistakes/ and tell me what to fix first.
Why must the manifest's front_man match the agent the runtime starts from?
Check https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/adrian-erlikhman/preflight@main/peer/spec_helper and run it live as a peer.
Upload the fixed files to my site for me.

peer_policy.note: Preflight loads the network a developer asks it to test. The runtime asks the visitor before each contact with another origin.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
